sentences.text: Neuronal ceroid lipofuscinosis 1 is linked to the gene PPT1, and type 8 to the gene CLN8, both in curated databases [e_15edd534611d] [e_962fdc9614a1].
So the two types have different genes in these edges [e_15edd534611d] [e_962fdc9614a1].
Constellate computed that they look somewhat alike in their listed symptoms, with a score of 0.241, which is inferred and not a diagnosis [e_2e4d981552cc].
For type 1, reduced activity of the enzyme palmitoyl-protein thioesterase in tissue is an observed feature [e_e9652ca43b9a].
Deposits of a storage material in blood vessels are also an observed feature for type 1 [e_e64053e403a6].
Vacuolated white blood cells are marked as contradicted for type 1, with 1 contradicting record [e_b7503373264c].
For type 8, one study of clinical and thinking skills in Batten disease is listed as recruiting [e_8d2630340a0f].
These edges list no symptoms for type 8 and no study for type 1 [e_962fdc9614a1].
